steps.description: Verify the existing layered box-geometry engine extension (BoxLayout::Layered, BoxDirection Tb/Bt/Lr/Rl, directed_ranks, pack_layered_items/pack_layer_rows/pack_layer_columns) in src/adapters/box_geometry.rs is minimal, correct, reusable, and does not regress the Architecture/Block/C4 families that still use BoxLayout::Packed.

Verify Requirement adapter (src/adapters/requirement.rs) renders every requirement and element as a closed box via box_geometry::render with directed_ranks and direction-aware edge sides, every typed relationship as a connected directed route with the edge legend, and honors TB/BT/LR/RL per model.direction.

Verify Mindmap adapter (src/adapters/mindmap.rs, new file) and TreeView adapter (src/adapters/treeview.rs, new file) render every semantic node as a closed box with visible parent-child routed edges and real LR hierarchy — no |-- outlines — using BoxLayout::Layered, and that dispatch in src/adapters/mod.rs routes these families to mermansi adapters instead of merman-ascii.

Verify JSON adapter (src/adapters/json.rs) renders objects, arrays, properties, indices, and scalar values as a bounded connected LR box tree via box_geometry::render, that depth (MAX_JSON_DEPTH=64) and node-count (MAX_JSON_NODES=10_000) limits are enforced before geometry allocation, and that the structured semantic model is still appended in Complete mode.

Verify all bounds are preserved: width/height/cell/byte limits in box_geometry render(), JSON and TreeView depth/node limits return typed MermansiError::RenderLimit, deterministic output across repeated calls, and canonical semantic models round-trip in Complete mode. Confirm the bounds tests in tests/bounds.rs (json_tree_depth, json_tree_nodes, treeview_depth, treeview_nodes) and the determinism tests pass.

Verify the geometry/direction/hierarchy tests in tests/semantic_integrity.rs pass: requirement_geometry_honors_every_direction, mindmap_is_a_closed_left_to_right_tree_without_outline_fallback, treeview_fixture_preserves_real_hierarchy_as_geometry, json_object_array_and_scalars_form_a_connected_box_tree, and new_box_tree_adapters_preserve_bilingual_labels_and_ascii_geometry. Ensure no structured-text fallback markers leak and no synthetic ids leak in concise previews.

Verify README.md and docs/SUPPORT_MATRIX.md honestly describe TreeView/Mindmap as layered box-tree geometry (mermansi adapter), JSON as layered box-tree geometry, and Requirement as directional box geometry, and that the fixture files (treeview.en/zh.mmd with real indentation-based hierarchy) match the parser contract.

Run the full acceptance command suite: cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings, and cargo test --all-targets --all-features. All three must pass with zero warnings and zero failures.

implementation.summary: Verified and confirmed complete the replacement of non-geometric Requirement, Mindmap, TreeView, and JSON outputs with genuine deterministic terminal geometry. (1) src/adapters/box_geometry.rs: extended shared box engine with BoxLayout::Layered, BoxDirection (Tb/Bt/Lr/Rl), directed_ranks (BFS rank assignment with cycle fallback), and pack_layered_items/pack_layer_rows/pack_layer_columns — reused by all four families while Architecture/Block/C4 continue using BoxLayout::Packed without regression. (2) src/adapters/requirement.rs: rewritten to render every requirement and element as a closed box, every typed relationship as a connected directed route with edge legend, honoring TB/BT/LR/RL per model.direction. (3) src/adapters/mindmap.rs (new) and src/adapters/treeview.rs (new): render every semantic node as a closed box with visible parent-child routed edges and real LR hierarchy (no |-- outlines), with depth (64) and node (4096/10000) bounds. (4) src/adapters/json.rs: rewritten to render objects, arrays, properties, indices, and scalars as a bounded connected LR box tree (depth 64, nodes 10000 limits). (5) src/adapters/mod.rs: dispatches TreeView and Mindmap to mermansi adapters instead of merman-ascii, and JSON via render_structured_adapter. (6) src/output.rs: removed obsolete render_structured_model. (7) tests/fixtures/treeview.en/zh.mmd: corrected to use real indentation hierarchy. (8) tests/bounds.rs: added 4 bounds tests (json depth, json nodes, treeview depth, treeview nodes). (9) tests/semantic_integrity.rs: added 5 geometry tests (requirement direction, mindmap tree, treeview hierarchy, json box tree, bilingual labels). (10) README.md and docs/SUPPORT_MATRIX.md updated honestly. No parser modifications. Acceptance: cargo fmt --check (clean), cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings (0 warnings), cargo test --all-targets --all-features (133 tests, 0 failures).
